text:
What to do:

Write a list of five activities you would like to do at the weekend. Both people should make a list – at the end you will talk about whose list is clearer and why!

  1. Begin with the opening phrase, "At the weekend, I like to".
  2. Think about the activities you are going to include and make sure at least some of them are possible.
  3. Before you write the list, think about the activities you are going to include and how it would be clearest to set it out.
  4. Write your list really clearly!


After you have both finished, compare your lists and talk about which is clearest and why. When you have decided which list is clearest, the loser can pick one activity from the winner's list to actually do!
